description: This file defines REST API routes for managing dashboards, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and archiving dashboard configurations. It uses FastAPI with MongoDB (Motor), and includes WebSocket broadcast helpers and user authentication dependencies.

classes.name: DashboardSummary
classes.description: A Pydantic model summarizing dashboard details such as ID, title, and description.

methods.name: create_dashboard_config( dashboard: DashboardConfigCreateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new dashboard configuration, ensuring the dashboard ID is unique per user, and broadcasts creation event.

methods.name: list_dashboards( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Lists all dashboards owned by the current user, excluding archived ones.

methods.name: get_dashboard_config( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dashboard configuration by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_dashboard_config( dashboard_id: str, update: DashboardConfigUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of a dashboard configuration and broadcasts the update.

methods.name: archive_dashboard_config( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Soft deletes (archives) a dashboard configuration and broadcasts the deletion event.

ctags.name: archive_dashboard_config
ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.signature: ( dashboard: DashboardConfigCreateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.name: get_dashboard_config
ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: str, update: DashboardConfigUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
